name: Hospital & Clinic Starter Pack
shortDescription: Antiseptic disinfectant liquid, bleach, floor and surface cleaners and hand wash for hospitals, clinics and pharmacies.
description: A bulk cleaning pack for hospitals, clinics, maternity homes and pharmacies: antiseptic disinfectant liquid and bleach for routine cleaning, floor and surface cleaners for wards and corridors, and body & hand wash for staff and patient wash areas. Use alongside your facility's own infection-control procedures.
ingredients: See each product's page for ingredients.
howToUse: Follow the directions on each product label.
safety: Keep all products out of reach of children and unauthorised persons. Never mix cleaning products. Store in a cool, dry place out of direct sunlight.
